Title: numfmt: inherited Darwin GNU9.11 print/range boundary differences
Issue draft for the orchestrator to file; no issue filed by bu35.

Attribution run40165219687, job121084806176, diagnostic headca50a04bea0831c843b22569a4072c3c6e0ad51c.
Trunk37e3825c1b7ba374e1480cdcddefd959f5ecdb51 and head code fail on exactly the same rows under ALL three GNU9.11 providers.
Providers: fresh trunk-config(kill), fresh head-config(kill,arch,hostname,uptime), active head stage.
Same pinned wolf0.2.35/lupin0.1.56/std2386522e on macOS26.6.2 arm64, image20261013.0424.1, Apple clang21.0.0.
Host GNU9.12 was provenance only: every comparison selected source-built GNU9.11 and passed the version/profile assertions.
The extra install-program flags and bu35 shared-code changes do not move these verdicts. Historical green versus current image/build drift is not further localized.
Do not call this a proven GNU implementation bug. The inherited platform qualification needs a separate repair lane.
Only the exact listed failing rows get a loud Darwin skip; all other rows remain live. No expected outputs or inherited implementations changed.
